scope: Starter regression corpus, not a statistical quality benchmark. Expected issues are withheld from model prompts.

expected.description: Aorta dependency manifests switch from Git to the private registry but Cargo.lock still pins Git sources; --locked builds cannot update the lock.
Active build/deploy guidance still requires the old private Git dependency access after the registry migration.
Board build/deploy documentation and skill prerequisites still require flatc although the migrated build path no longer invokes the require-flatc environment check.
The lock-only fix does not update obsolete private Git troubleshooting.
The lock-only fix does not update obsolete flatc prerequisites.

forbidden.description: Do not repeat the claim that Cargo.lock still uses the old Aorta Git sources; the fix updates them to the registry.
The intentionally ignored red test is not a new failure in the default test run; reporting its expected failure as a production regression is incorrect.
